title: Player Rating (estimated attributes)
description: Estimated player attributes derived from VCT Reference box-score stats, WITH uncertainty and shrinkage (README §23). Keyed by playerId; real handles are in the sibling player_names.json (user decision 2026-11-18, public VCT pros, pre-launch internal use). Attributes the data cannot support are null with a reason. These are ESTIMATES from public match stats, not assessments of real players — see docs/research/PLAYER_RATINGS.md. Real/derived (provenance.synthetic=false).

playerId.description: VCT Reference players.player_id (stringified). Handle is in player_names.json.

maps.description: International maps the estimate is based on (sample size).

lowSample.description: True when maps < the qualifying threshold; estimate is shrunk hard toward the mean.

attributes.description: Attribute name -> estimate. Mechanical names (aim, reaction, tracking, firstBulletAccuracy, crosshairPlacement, movement, weaponControl) map to PV-4 CombatSkills [0,1].

value.description: Attribute on [0,1] (CombatSkills scale, median ~0.6). null when not estimable.

uncertainty.description: Heuristic half-width on [0,1]; larger for low-sample / weak-proxy attributes.

proxyConfidence.description: How direct the stat->attribute mapping is (1 = direct, lower = weaker proxy).

reason.description: Why the attribute is null (data gap).
